## Does this belong in Worldcast?

Worldcast is intentionally a thin bridge. Features tend to fit here if they:

- Compose WorldMonitor + MiroFish in a new way
- Improve the notification / matching loop
- Make the bridge or UI more reliable

Features that probably belong upstream:

- New globe layers, news sources, intelligence feeds → [WorldMonitor](https://github.com/koala73/worldmonitor)
- Agent model, memory, simulation tuning → [MiroFish](https://github.com/666ghj/MiroFish)

- [ ] I think this belongs in Worldcast
- [ ] Not sure — happy to discuss
